newsitem.title: UK: Libya raises June term crude formulas 5-10 cents.
newsitem.headline: Libya raises June term crude formulas 5-10 cents.

text.p: Libya's National Oil Company (NOC) raised most term crude contract price formulas by 5-10 cents for June liftings, oil traders said.
Es Sider for June will be priced at Dated Brent -35 cents, up five cents from May.
Also raised five cents were Sirtica at Brent -20 cents, Amna at Brent -70 cents, Sarir at Brent -65 cents and Bu Attifel at Brent -35 cents.
Premier grades Brega and Zuetina both were raised by 10 cents to Brent plus 30 cents and plus 25 cents respectively.
Offshore Bouri was left unchanged for June at Iranian Heavy -35 cents fob Sidi Kreir.
